word_limit_counts: No body word limit stated in the RR guidelines or the Stage 1 template; measured against the template's section list instead.
abstract_notes: No references in the abstract. Open with a sentence introducing the general topic for a broad audience, then the specific questions, what will be done, and broadly what results would confirm or disconfirm the hypotheses.
max_display_items_notes: 8 combined figures+tables permitted at Stage 2; non-essential display items go to Supplementary Information.
required_sections: Introduction (no subheadings permitted; must contain the hypotheses and the call-out to the mandatory Design Table as Table 1)
Code availability statement (separate from Data availability)
reference_style: Nature: superscript numerals in order of mention. Reference list holds only published/accepted works, recognized-preprint-server preprints, published conference abstracts, numbered patents, and DOI-bearing research datasets. Unpublished manuscripts only parenthetically in text.
code_availability_notes: Must provide a link (e.g. GitHub, OSF) to a live version of the code; simulation, power-analysis and pilot-data code in the same location; available for peer review, embargo until Stage 2 acceptance permitted.
preprint_policy: Stage 1 protocols registered on a recognized repository after IPA (publicly or under embargo); NHB offers figshare hosting.
notes: Stage 1 review criteria: importance/broad relevance; ability of the study to answer the question; logic and plausibility of hypotheses; soundness and feasibility of methodology and analysis pipeline including power analysis; replicable methodological detail preventing undisclosed flexibility; sufficient outcome-neutral tests, positive controls and quality checks.

Sampling plan: frequentist plans need a priori power >= 0.95 from the lowest meaningful effect size; Bayes-factor plans must guarantee collection until BF >= 10 or justify a maximum feasible sample size at which inconclusive results would still matter.
Interpretation of all potential data patterns must be committed to; null results interpretable only via Bayesian methods or equivalence testing.
Future tense for all prospective methods and analyses; only tense changes allowed at Stage 2.
No causal language for correlational evidence.
No priority or novelty claims anywhere.
A timeline for completion and proposed Stage 2 resubmission date must be included.
Design Table columns prescribed: Question | Hypothesis | Sampling plan | Analysis Plan | Interpretation given to different outcomes.
Secondary registrations welcome given evidence of no prior data access (self-certification or independent gatekeeper letter).

Stage 1 cover letter: scientific case; support in place; data collection (for secondary RRs: pre-registered analyses) not started; anticipated timeline; agreement to share raw data, materials, code and lab log; agreement to register approved protocol; agreement to Withdrawn Registrations summary.
Blinding statement required if applicable; randomization statement required if applicable.
Ethics approval required before AIP, not necessarily at submission.
